No. The evidence shows tree-cover loss across about **81.3 hectares**, or **2.23%** of the 3,643.5-hectare property, in 2021—not the whole property. A further 37.3 hectares of loss was mapped in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event.

Most of the 81.3-hectare event area was mapped as planted forest. The data do not establish whether the loss was caused by clearing, harvesting, fire or another cause.
